description: Works to Hawthorn tree covered by LBE ORDER NO (128) 1981: fell to ground level.
decision_conditions: This consent is valid for two years.Reason: In order that the nature of work pertaining to this consent remains appropriate.

Before the works hereby permitted commence on site, full details and specifications of proposals to provide one hawthorn tree 10-12cm 'Standard' to replace that removed by virtue of this consent, shall be submitted to the Local Planning Authority. The proposal must be undertaken at the site in the first planting season [November to March] or part thereof following the commencement of works on site.  The Local Planning Authority shall be informed in writing once the replacement tree has been planted.Reason: In the interests of visual amenity and in order to maintain tree population at this site after the removal of the preserved tree and in accordance with the requirements of Section 206 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990.

Tree work should not be carried out during periods that are likely to interfere with or disturb breeding birds or mammals.Reason: In order to comply with the requirements of the Wildlife and Countryside Act 1981.
